title: Mountain View Marina

services.name: Paddle Boards and Kayaks
services.desc: Mountain View Marina proudly features a wide variety of boat rentals on beautiful Lake Hiwassee in Murphy, NC. Whether your planning an afternoon of fun in the sun or an exciting family vacation, we have the watercraft and friendly staff to meet your needs. Our Tritoon Boats are great for swimming or sightseeing with 150hp Yamaha engines. Reservations are highly recommended. Half day and hourly rentals reservations may be restricted to weekdays only during heavy demand. On or after May 1, 2010 any person under the age of 26 must complete a NASBLA approved boating education course before operating any vessel propelled by a motor of 10 HP or greater. Please review our Boat Rental Guidelines
